title: Two Microseconds, Two Futures
question: Can a small handling-clock change move a feeding event across a decision boundary?
method: Pinned DEEP fork; independent intervention replay and exact terminal identity comparison.
finding: A two-microsecond stored-credit difference changes which side of a decision the meal falls on and the final consumed patch set.
claim_scope: Seed 31001, controlled checkpoint 150.1 s, dt 0.05 s, endpoint 180 s.
limitations: No general chaos, biological calibration or numerical convergence claim.
Exact cross-platform replay amended; earlier natural trajectory cause open.
